title: [박물관] 2026년 인하대학교박물관-한국역사연구회 공동 학술회의 개최 안내

summary: 별도의 사전 신청 안내는 없으며, 당일 13:00부터 등록 및 개회식이 진행됩니다.

en.title: [Museum] Notice of 2026 Joint Academic Conference by Inha University Museum and Korean History Association
summary: Inha University Museum (인하대학교박물관) and the Korean History Association (한국역사연구회) are co-hosting an academic conference.
The theme is 'War and Industry that Shaped Modern and Contemporary Incheon' (근현대 인천을 만든 전쟁과 산업).
It will be held on Friday, October 16, 2026, from 13:00 to 18:00.
The venue is the Grand Conference Room (Room 523) on the 5th floor of the Jungseok Memorial Library (정석학술정보관).
No pre-registration details are provided; on-site registration and the opening ceremony will take place from 13:00.
en.easyExplanation: Inha University Museum and the Korean History Association are hosting a joint academic conference on 'War and Industry that Shaped Modern and Contemporary Incheon.' Anyone interested can attend the event at the Grand Conference Room (Room 523) on the 5th floor of the Jungseok Memorial Library on Friday, October 16, 2026, starting at 1:00 PM.
